title: The docs tell users to click a UI Builder button; the shipped control is named UI Editor and UI Builder appears nowhere
statement: interface-builder/index.md tells the reader to click the UI Builder button to toggle between Edit and View mode. The application's own empty-state text says to click the UI Editor icon, and the control's accessible name is UI Editor. The string UI Builder does not appear anywhere in the rendered application.

handVerified.note: Report section 11. The accessible names of every top-bar control were enumerated: UI Editor, highlight, setting, bell, question-circle, user. getByLabel('UI Builder') returns 0 and getByTitle('UI Editor') returns 1. The report corrects the findings.md cite for the v2 topbar from :378 to :381.

source.howDecided: git log d8d8cb4b..origin/main -- <culprit files> returned 0 commits for every file in this finding. The only three commits since the tested SHA are 24a620efb8 and 032a4f6913 (lerna version bumps, packages/*/package.json and lerna.json only) and ba00bcebc2 (CHANGELOG.md, CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md). The culprit lines were then re-read at origin/main and match the report's quotes.

citedItems.stateAtReport: open, touches the docs nav label only
citedItems.stateToday: open, not merged, base develop, last updated 2026-01-05
citedItems.note: A translation PR that includes the UI Builder nav label. It does not address the button-name drift and has been idle for over seven months.

reevaluation: The finding stands unchanged. None of the three files has a commit since the tested SHA: the doc sentence is verbatim at interface-builder/index.md:5 (and the page title is # UI Builder at :1), DesignableSwitch.tsx:44 still renders Tooltip title={t('UI Editor')}, and TopbarActionModel.tsx:381 still sets tooltip = tExpr('UI Editor'), confirming the report's :378 to :381 correction. The UI Builder title search returned five items, four of which are feature or docs PRs that predate the tested SHA (#10105 docs, #9526, #9331, #9254 API work) and the fifth is the already-cited #7758. Unreported.
notes: Use the corrected cite TopbarActionModel.tsx:381. The page's own H1 is UI Builder as well, so the fix is a naming decision across the page rather than one word, and a maintainer may prefer to rename the control instead of the doc; say the drift plainly and let them pick. Do not comment on #7758: it is a stale translation PR on develop and would bury the report.
